title: Verify creating a Discount template
custom_preconds: 1. On the admin Fees & Discounts page.
custom_steps:
1. Click 'New Fee / Discount'.
2. Set Type 'Discount'; Calculation Type '% of Subtotal'; Name 'ZZAUTOTEST Loyalty'; Percent 8; set the Taxable Yes/No dropdown to No.
3. Click 'Create'.
custom_expected:
1. The save succeeds and a success message appears (a generic message, not a per-type 'Discount added').
2. The list shows 'ZZAUTOTEST Loyalty', Type Discount, Calculation Type % of Subtotal, Amount −8%, Taxable No.
